descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94699 AC 2 · ““Last refreshed” = a new value was recorded; saving without one doesn’t reset the clock”.

Bug B04 · S0 · new

A pre-round Save Note with no vitals re-stamps yesterday's BP, creatinine and one-time doses with today's time ('Given · Oct 13' becomes today), so old values look current and never expire

Tickets: TFA-92588 ready for pr; TFA-92597 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Re-check on the PR #100/#101 branch Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745): TC-10/S12 cp3 / cp8 show the same mechanism after a summary retry: yesterday's temperature and BP stay on the panel, dated today. Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: changed: a Save Note no longer re-stamps BP / HR / creatinine; the live model still echoes yesterday's one-time magnesium dose and the merge dates it today (TC-19/S12). Re-test 2026-10-20 (package b04, local, UTC browsers): #100/#101 fixed the path where the parse returns nothing (no stamp moves, values clear at +18 h; imaging and held/stopped/active rows safe). Still wrong when the parse echoes yesterday's values: vitals/labs re-stamped now and shown as Today, an invented BP accepted, the one-time magnesium Given Oct 19 -> Oct 20; the echo resets the retention clocks (Hospital +18 h, NH 3 more visits). Code: usePreRoundProcess.ts:182-202, 230-270; useSnfPreRoundProcess.ts:239-251, 265-275; convex/lib/medications.ts:371-372, 437, 447, 455 (guard at 402-409 covers only active). Dev x/10 pending (sign-in revoked at 18:10 JST). Dev 2026-10-20 (live, UTC browsers, 10 charts + 3 controls): one-time magnesium re-dated Given Oct 19 -> Oct 20 in 3/10 (all Hospital: 3/5; NH 0/5, the model returned no meds); vitals / labs / imaging re-dated 0/10 (the model echoed none); held / stopped / active rows 10/10 kept; controls 3/3. Fix: extend the not-dictated guard at medications.ts:402-409 to single-dose; stamp pre-round vitals / labs only when dictated and changed.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-19/S12

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S12 'Last refreshed' = a new value: saves without a new value do not restart the 36 h clock

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 'Last refreshed' for vitals, labs and imaging means a new value was recorded: saving (pre-round Save Note, a panel save, Generate) without a new value does not restart their 36 h clock. … (TFA-94699 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U4 Hospital vitals, labs and imaging are deleted 36 h after they were last refreshed: a vital and a lab not refreshed for 37 h are gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: vitals, labs, imaging 36 h)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Two Hospital patients with BP 136/84, Cr 1.3 and the imaging line 'CXR: no infiltrate' recorded at T0 (aging helper)

When At T0+24 h on patient 1: a pre-round Save Note whose text has no vitals, labs or imaging, the Vitals, Labs and Imaging panels opened and saved unchanged, and a Generate. On patient 2: the same, plus a new BP 128/80 recorded. Then age both to T0+37 h and purge

Then Patient 1: BP, Cr and the CXR line gone at T0+37 h (their clock never moved). Patient 2: the new BP stays until T0+24+36 h; Cr and the CXR line, not re-recorded, are gone at T0+37 h

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94699 AC 2 (T1, vitals / labs / imaging) and UAT 3.7 ('cleared 36 h after last refreshed'): a value that survives T0+37 h only because of a save without a new value = Fail; whether a re-dictated identical value counts is Q5

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94699 in progress

Yesterday's vitals and labs never age out while the physician keeps working: a pre-round Save Note with no vitals or labs in it re-records yesterday's BP and creatinine with a fresh clock (adding a duplicate 'Creatinine 1.3' row), and saving a panel unchanged also restarts its 36 h clock.

Evidence: allure ac6b8d0a-…-result.json; retention lane (backend log convex-5910.log lines 77-86). 1 check passes, 9 fail: 4 known (K8, unchanged panel saves), 5 not in the matrix knownGaps. The new part is the Save Note echo: usePreRoundProcess sends the values on file as context and writes back whatever the model returns. It is intermittent (live AI): 2/2 charts in this run, 3/4 and 2/4 in earlier runs. It is not in the dev report or ledger. Breaks TFA-94699 AC 2 and UAT 3.7. The Generate leg was not run (Generate is forbidden locally).

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

B04 on 8b4be94a: CHANGED (fixed by #100 for a parse that returns nothing; still re-dates whatever the parse echoes). (a) nothing returned: vitalsRecordedAt, labs[].recordedAt, vitalsUpdatedAt, labsUpdatedAt, radiologyUpdatedAt unchanged, panel shows 'Oct 19' under every value, Hospital clears BP/HR/temp/SpO2, Cr/K and the X-ray line at +18 h (T0 38 h): PASS, both contexts. (b) parse echoes yesterday's BP/HR/temp/SpO2 and Cr/K unchanged, or (c) with today's date: every echoed value is stamped now and the panel reads 'Today' under all four vitals and both labs; vitalsUpdatedAt / labsUpdatedAt move to now, so in Hospital yesterday's values survive +18 h and clear only 36 h after the echo (usePreRoundProcess.ts:182-202, 230-270; useSnfPreRoundProcess.ts:239-251, 265-275: any non-empty parsed value is written and stamped, there is no check that today's dictation names it or that it differs from the value on file, unlike the panel save vitalsSavePatch / labsSavePatch in convex/lib/objectiveDates.ts:147-214). Imaging: an echoed X-ray line is dropped by scrubUnnamedStudies (usePreRoundProcess.ts:305-308) and radiologyUpdatedAt never moves: PASS in all variants (Nursing Home Save Note does not merge imaging). (d) an invented BP (dictation names none) is accepted and stamped today, HR/temp/SpO2 keep 'Oct 19'; (e) dictated BP 128/76 stamped today, others keep yesterday: PASS. Recorded (our observation, not judged): one column clock per block (vitalsUpdatedAt), so a new BP keeps yesterday's HR/temp/SpO2 on the chart past 36 h (dated 'Oct 19'). Nursing Home has no hour window for vitals / labs (recorded). UAT 3.6 / 3.7, TFA-94699 AC 2.
